text:
lia-design: dropped an alternative nav mock in Figma -> https://figma.com/file/y/compact-rail-v2. Idea: group items into 3 sticky clusters (Models | Serving | Insights) but keep rows denser and add inline permalinks on each row. want quick sanity check on deep-link behavior + back button UX. thoughts? :mag:
omar-ux: compactness looks good for power users. question: if someone lands on a deep link like /w/:ws/models/:id?tab=versions, should we animate open the group then scroll to item or navigate instantly without animation? also what happens to browser back (list scroll restoration)?
ravi-frontend: prefer deterministic behavior: load nested URL, expand parent group without animation (reduce flakiness), scroll into view, then set focus to the panel heading. for back/forward we should persist list scroll in history state. rough API: history.pushState({scrollY, open: 'versions'}, '', href); on popstate restore. need to guard for direct loads (no history state).
nina-pm: copy consistency: let's standardize on "Models" (not Model Registry). breadcrumb affordance should be humanized: "Acme Corp • Models • MyCoolModel" not raw parameter names. permalinks are great — make them subtle but discoverable.
sam-a11y: a11y checklist: 1) group headers role=button, aria-expanded toggles. 2) when opened programmatically announce with aria-live polite: e.g., "Models expanded, 6 items". 3) when deep-link opens panel move focus to <h1> of the panel (tabindex=-1) and call focus(). 4) permalink icon must have aria-label="Copy link to model" and be reachable by keyboard. 5) ensure 24px min hit target and focus indicator.
lia-design: good — also thinking tooltip text for permalinks: "Copy link" -> change to "Copy model link" per nina.
omar-ux: one behavioral edge: if user toggles group then navigates in-app to detail, pressing back should not collapse the group unexpectedly. i.e., history state should remember expanded state. Ravi, can pushState include openGroup flag?
ravi-frontend: yes. pushState({scrollY, openGroup: 'models', tab: 'versions'}) on internal nav. on popstate we check state.openGroup and restore expand/collapse. tests needed for direct loads vs SPA nav.
navbot: route-lint-bot: test failures: history-restore.spec.js failing on /w/:ws/models sequence. CI job #4592.
lia-design: action items: 1) ravi open PR implementing history state + unit tests. 2) sam to produce a11y acceptance criteria snippet we can paste into PR. 3) design to update Figma copy to "Models" and change tooltip to "Copy model link". 4) QA to add an exploratory case for back-button/scroll restore. linking GH issues soon. thanks! :sparkles:
